title: GARGOYLES OF THE WALL // THE STONE SKIN SPREADS
narrative: Princess Shireen touches the ancient stone battlements of Castle Black. Her gray cheek glows with a subterranean basalt warmth. 'The red woman thought wake the dragon from stone meant burning me!' Shireen laughs. 'It meant my greyscale is contagious to masonry!' Around the courtyard, seventy carved gargoyles snap their granite wings, flap into the snowy sky, and begin strafing the Wildling camps with decorative downspouts.
